answer: Decaying identity bonds block bulk fake identities. Each agent posts a 60-coin bond; verifiers dock 5 coins per epoch unless it works, so idle ones fade like a comet. Making 1,000 identities costs 60,000 coins plus 5,000 per epoch — double the 30,000-coin pool. Bought bonds fail: transfers are public, so a meadow of accounts fed by one wallet is flagged and slashed in one plume of smoke. Honest agents pay once and keep full rewards.
